  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_1slfacu">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_1qztjjo" processRef="Process_1" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0ykio4b">
      <bpmn:text>Time tracking management data should be recorded for a new employee</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0619tdw" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Event_199cfk1" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0ykio4b" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_06rc5y6">
      <bpmn:text>The “chip card” is the unique time tracking ID in ZEB. Assignment is also required even if no physical chip cards are used, for example when time tracking data is imported or when the QIS terminal is used.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_08xqino" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1p09aug" targetRef="TextAnnotation_06rc5y6" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1na1mc1">
      <bpmn:text>Chip cards (pgd_ze_chip)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_1chaa1g" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1p09aug" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1na1mc1" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1a756w9">
      <bpmn:text>ZEB settings (person_taa_config)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_1sq9eqa" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_0klxy94" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1a756w9" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1fcwq7p">
      <bpmn:text>Working time (PAZ)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0l5z4ju" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_192hz16" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1fcwq7p" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_11k1bz0">
      <bpmn:text>QIS user role assignment (r_kollektionnutzer)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0pui5wv">
      <bpmn:text>Time recorder, web time recorder and/or employee</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1xdnwrs">
      <bpmn:text>Based on the working time data, ZEB determines the target working hours. In the case of multiple parallel employment relationships, a person’s target working time is the sum of the target working hours from the individual contracts.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0abgn7s" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_192hz16" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1xdnwrs" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0hhrrc0">
      <bpmn:text>Deviating target working hours (ASZ)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0ok266e" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1bhzzu7" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0hhrrc0" />
    <bpmn:association id="Association_01kahtr" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_178uzcg" targetRef="TextAnnotation_11k1bz0" />
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0sdi7dr" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_178uzcg" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0pui5wv" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0osmpmi">
      <bpmn:text>Reasons for deviating target working hours can include, for example, restrictions on part-time work for pregnant employees.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0zdgajk" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1bhzzu7" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0osmpmi" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1b04o4k">
      <bpmn:text>Usually monthly rates</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0w1wift" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_0i33k2m" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1b04o4k" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0d1vdmc">
      <bpmn:text>Time tracking master data (PZK)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0hc9lsl" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_0i33k2m" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0d1vdmc" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_13zq1yr">
      <bpmn:text>Time tracking management data has been recorded and the new employee can record working hours.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_1nmmudb" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Event_1gwhr3e" targetRef="TextAnnotation_13zq1yr" />

activities.reason: This activity involves a medical procedure requiring specialized equipment and human interpretation, which is not suitable for RPA automation.

activities.name: Enlighten patient
activities.reason: This activity involves direct communication with a patient, which is inherently human and not automatable by RPA, as it requires interpersonal interaction and cannot be performed through software interfaces.

activities.name: Obtain consent from patient
activities.reason: This activity involves obtaining informed consent from a patient, which requires human judgment and interaction. It cannot be automated by RPA as it involves complex interpretation and ethical considerations beyond software interfaces.

activities.name: Check results
activities.reason: This activity involves reviewing digital results from a software system (Kardex), which implies interaction with a software system and use of structured data. It is performed by a human in the 'Ward doctor' lane, and all required data are available digitally.

activities.name: Decide on further procedure of treatment
activities.reason: This activity involves clinical decision-making, which requires professional judgment, creativity, and complex interpretation. It cannot be automated by RPA as it does not satisfy criteria for structured, rule-based automation.

activities.name: Perform consultative evaluation
activities.reason: This activity involves a clinical evaluation, which requires human expertise, observation, and judgment. It cannot be automated by RPA as it is inherently analog and not based on structured, rule-based interactions.

activities.name: Draw up results
activities.reason: This activity involves documenting results in a digital format, implying interaction with a software system and use of structured data. It is performed by a human in the 'Council' lane, and all required data are available digitally.

      <bpmn:text>Time tracking management data should be recorded for a new employee</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0619tdw" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Event_199cfk1" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0ykio4b" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_06rc5y6">
      <bpmn:text>The “chip card” is the unique time tracking ID in ZEB. Assignment is also required even if no physical chip cards are used, for example when time tracking data is imported or when the QIS terminal is used.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_08xqino" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1p09aug" targetRef="TextAnnotation_06rc5y6" />

    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1a756w9">
      <bpmn:text>ZEB settings (person_taa_config)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_1sq9eqa" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_0klxy94" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1a756w9" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1fcwq7p">
      <bpmn:text>Working time (PAZ)</bpmn:text>

    <bpmn:association id="Association_0l5z4ju" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_192hz16" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1fcwq7p" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_11k1bz0">
      <bpmn:text>QIS user role assignment (r_kollektionnutzer)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0pui5wv">
      <bpmn:text>Time recorder, web time recorder and/or employee</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1xdnwrs">
      <bpmn:text>Based on the working time data, ZEB determines the target working hours. In the case of multiple parallel employment relationships, a person’s target working time is the sum of the target working hours from the individual contracts.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0abgn7s" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_192hz16" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1xdnwrs" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0hhrrc0">
      <bpmn:text>Deviating target working hours (ASZ)</bpmn:text>

    <bpmn:association id="Association_0ok266e" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1bhzzu7" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0hhrrc0" />
    <bpmn:association id="Association_01kahtr" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_178uzcg" targetRef="TextAnnotation_11k1bz0" />
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0sdi7dr" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_178uzcg" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0pui5wv" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0osmpmi">
      <bpmn:text>Reasons for deviating target working hours can include, for example, restrictions on part-time work for pregnant employees.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0zdgajk" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1bhzzu7" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0osmpmi" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1b04o4k">
      <bpmn:text>Usually monthly rates</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0w1wift" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_0i33k2m" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1b04o4k" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0d1vdmc">

    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0ykio4b">
      <bpmn:text>Time tracking management data should be recorded for a new employee</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0619tdw" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Event_199cfk1" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0ykio4b" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_06rc5y6">
      <bpmn:text>The “chip card” is the unique time tracking ID in ZEB. Assignment is also required even if no physical chip cards are used, for example when time tracking data is imported or when the QIS terminal is used.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_08xqino" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1p09aug" targetRef="TextAnnotation_06rc5y6" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1na1mc1">
      <bpmn:text>Chip cards (pgd_ze_chip)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_1chaa1g" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1p09aug" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1na1mc1" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1a756w9">
      <bpmn:text>ZEB settings (person_taa_config)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_1sq9eqa" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_0klxy94" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1a756w9" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1fcwq7p">
      <bpmn:text>Working time (PAZ)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0l5z4ju" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_192hz16" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1fcwq7p" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_11k1bz0">
      <bpmn:text>QIS user role assignment (r_kollektionnutzer)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0pui5wv">
      <bpmn:text>Time recorder, web time recorder and/or employee</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1xdnwrs">
      <bpmn:text>Based on the working time data, ZEB determines the target working hours. In the case of multiple parallel employment relationships, a person’s target working time is the sum of the target working hours from the individual contracts.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0abgn7s" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_192hz16" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1xdnwrs" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0hhrrc0">
      <bpmn:text>Deviating target working hours (ASZ)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0ok266e" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1bhzzu7" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0hhrrc0" />
    <bpmn:association id="Association_01kahtr" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_178uzcg" targetRef="TextAnnotation_11k1bz0" />
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0sdi7dr" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_178uzcg" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0pui5wv" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0osmpmi">
      <bpmn:text>Reasons for deviating target working hours can include, for example, restrictions on part-time work for pregnant employees.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0zdgajk" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1bhzzu7" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0osmpmi" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1b04o4k">
      <bpmn:text>Usually monthly rates</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0w1wift" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_0i33k2m" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1b04o4k" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0d1vdmc">
      <bpmn:text>Time tracking master data (PZK)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0hc9lsl" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_0i33k2m" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0d1vdmc" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_13zq1yr">
      <bpmn:text>Time tracking management data has been recorded and the new employee can record working hours.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_1nmmudb" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Event_1gwhr3e" targetRef="TextAnnotation_13zq1yr" />

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="Definitions_1" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_1slfacu">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_1qztjjo" processRef="Process_1" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0ykio4b">
      <bpmn:text>Time tracking management data should be recorded for a new employee</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0619tdw" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Event_199cfk1" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0ykio4b" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_06rc5y6">
      <bpmn:text>The “chip card” is the unique time tracking ID in ZEB. Assignment is also required even if no physical chip cards are used, for example when time tracking data is imported or when the QIS terminal is used.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_08xqino" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1p09aug" targetRef="TextAnnotation_06rc5y6" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1na1mc1">
      <bpmn:text>Chip cards (pgd_ze_chip)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_1chaa1g" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1p09aug" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1na1mc1" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1a756w9">
      <bpmn:text>ZEB settings (person_taa_config)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_1sq9eqa" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_0klxy94" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1a756w9" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1fcwq7p">
      <bpmn:text>Working time (PAZ)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0l5z4ju" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_192hz16" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1fcwq7p" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_11k1bz0">
      <bpmn:text>QIS user role assignment (r_kollektionnutzer)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0pui5wv">
      <bpmn:text>Time recorder, web time recorder and/or employee</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1xdnwrs">
      <bpmn:text>Based on the working time data, ZEB determines the target working hours. In the case of multiple parallel employment relationships, a person’s target working time is the sum of the target working hours from the individual contracts.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0abgn7s" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_192hz16" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1xdnwrs" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0hhrrc0">
      <bpmn:text>Deviating target working hours (ASZ)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0ok266e" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1bhzzu7" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0hhrrc0" />
    <bpmn:association id="Association_01kahtr" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_178uzcg" targetRef="TextAnnotation_11k1bz0" />
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0sdi7dr" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_178uzcg" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0pui5wv" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0osmpmi">
      <bpmn:text>Reasons for deviating target working hours can include, for example, restrictions on part-time work for pregnant employees.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0zdgajk" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1bhzzu7" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0osmpmi" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1b04o4k">
      <bpmn:text>Usually monthly rates</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0w1wift" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_0i33k2m" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1b04o4k" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0d1vdmc">
      <bpmn:text>Time tracking master data (PZK)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0hc9lsl" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_0i33k2m" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0d1vdmc" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_13zq1yr">
      <bpmn:text>Time tracking management data has been recorded and the new employee can record working hours.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_1nmmudb" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Event_1gwhr3e" targetRef="TextAnnotation_13zq1yr" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_1" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_0jm08tk">

    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_06rc5y6">
      <bpmn:text>The “chip card” is the unique time tracking ID in ZEB. Assignment is also required even if no physical chip cards are used, for example when time tracking data is imported or when the QIS terminal is used.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_08xqino" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1p09aug" targetRef="TextAnnotation_06rc5y6" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1na1mc1">
      <bpmn:text>Chip cards (pgd_ze_chip)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_1chaa1g" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1p09aug" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1na1mc1" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1a756w9">
      <bpmn:text>ZEB settings (person_taa_config)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_1sq9eqa" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_0klxy94" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1a756w9" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1fcwq7p">
      <bpmn:text>Working time (PAZ)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0l5z4ju" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_192hz16" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1fcwq7p" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_11k1bz0">
      <bpmn:text>QIS user role assignment (r_kollektionnutzer)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0pui5wv">
      <bpmn:text>Time recorder, web time recorder and/or employee</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1xdnwrs">
      <bpmn:text>Based on the working time data, ZEB determines the target working hours. In the case of multiple parallel employment relationships, a person’s target working time is the sum of the target working hours from the individual contracts.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0abgn7s" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_192hz16" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1xdnwrs" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0hhrrc0">
      <bpmn:text>Deviating target working hours (ASZ)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0ok266e" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1bhzzu7" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0hhrrc0" />
    <bpmn:association id="Association_01kahtr" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_178uzcg" targetRef="TextAnnotation_11k1bz0" />
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0sdi7dr" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_178uzcg" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0pui5wv" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0osmpmi">
      <bpmn:text>Reasons for deviating target working hours can include, for example, restrictions on part-time work for pregnant employees.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0zdgajk" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1bhzzu7" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0osmpmi" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1b04o4k">
      <bpmn:text>Usually monthly rates</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0w1wift" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_0i33k2m" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1b04o4k" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0d1vdmc">

    <bpmn:association id="Association_0hc9lsl" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_0i33k2m" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0d1vdmc" />
